title: Annotatio III §.VIII close: Pius IV bull curse (Rome, 13 Nov 1564); stop before §.IX Form from Lombard/Aquinas
pass_a_gloss: Nor finally did they delay this article further, the thirteenth of the Roman Symbol, being closed with such an Epiphonema and threat of the Pope: Therefore let it be lawful for none of all men to infringe this page of our will and mandate or to contradict it by rash daring. But if anyone shall presume to attempt this, let him know he will incur the indignation of almighty God and of His blessed Apostles Peter and Paul. Given at Rome at St. Peter’s, in the Year of the Lord’s Incarnation 1564, on the Ides of November.
pass_b_english: That thirteenth Roman-Symbol article closes with Pius IV’s threat: none may infringe this page; presumers incur God’s and Peter and Paul’s indignation.
Dated Rome at St. Peter’s, 13 November 1564 (Ides).
Stop before §.IX (Form from Lombard / Aquinas / Hoc est corpus meum).
source_text: Nec denique morati articulum insuper hunc, Symboli Romani XIIItium tali Epiphonemate & interminatione Papæ claudi: Nulli ergo omnium hominum liceat hanc paginam nostræ voluntatis & mandati infringere vel ei ausu temerario contraire. Si quis autem hoc attentare præsumpserit, indignationem omnipotentis Dei ac beatorum Petri & Pauli Apostolorum ejus, se noverit incursurum. Datum Romæ ap. S. Petrum, Anno Incarnationis Domini 1564. Idibus Novembris.
